summary.value: Tell users which fields are required and which are optional. Where all fields are required, say so once above the form; where the form mixes both, mark each field individually. Never use an asterisk as the marker.

value.role: single-line input; carries its own `label` prop

value: All fields required: state it once above the form; do not mark each field.
Mixed required and optional: mark every field individually so the marking is unambiguous.
The marker is a word — 'Required' / 'Optional' — rendered as a Tag beside the label.
ToggleGroup is a group control: wrap it in a Fieldset with a legend, or give it an accessible name directly.

a11y.source: WCAG 3.3.2 (Labels or Instructions), WCAG 1.3.1 (Info and Relationships), packages/react/src/components/toggle-group/index.ts JSDoc

value.rule: Every input has a programmatic label — Textfield's `label` prop or a Label component.
A ToggleGroup carries an accessible name: aria-label/aria-labelledby, or a Fieldset legend. The component's own JSDoc example uses aria-label.
Required state is conveyed programmatically (`required` or `aria-required`), not by the visible marker alone.
Do not use an asterisk to indicate required fields — stated by the pattern docs; an unexplained symbol is not an instruction.

value: This pattern governs MARKING, not validation. Error handling belongs to the errors pattern.
ToggleGroup is for switching between views or a small set of choices; for a form answer the docs direct you to Radio instead.
Do not invent props on ToggleGroup: the documented surface is variant, value, defaultValue, onChange, name (+ ToggleGroup.Item: value, icon).
